items: 【COMFORTABLE SEATING】A 24.8" wide seat, a 0.5" thick soft cushion, and height-adjustable armrests... all these features ensure an optimal seating experience

【FULL SUPPORT】With a 39.2" high backrest, this camping chair offers ideal shoulder and back support. In addition, the lumbar support is height adjustable as required, snuggly conforming to your body for ultimate comfort during use

【EVERYTHING AT HAND】The armrests are equipped with cup holders and a cooler bag to keep your drinks cool and fresh, and the fabric organiser keeps your mobile phone or magazines tidy—everything you need is within easy reach

【STURDY AND DURABLE】With the strong steel tubes (0.9" dia.) and reinforced joints on the frame, the fishing chair offers stable support. Made from 600D Oxford fabric with a water-resistant coating, this chair is wear-resistant and durable

【READY TO USE & EASY TO CARRY】This folding chair arrives pre-assembled for immediate use. For easy portability, carry it with the shoulder strap or pack it in the included bag, which is secured by a hook-and-loop fastener
